items.question: Under what condition are beings said to endure torment in the count of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: A count of eighty-four thousand is specified.
These occur within womb-diagrams as a location.
Beings are described as tormented in that setting.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The agent of torment remains unspecified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
